hooks.command: echo "FIRST, before any tool call: list every separate ask in this message. Questions you can answer from what you know: answer them in your first reply, one line each. Everything else (research, design options, code, bugs): launch its agents in ONE parallel batch in that same first response. Never work one ask yourself while the others wait. REMINDER: anything beyond a one-line fix (features, bug reports, 'work through the items', several asks in one message) runs the delegate-workflow skill: say the chunks first, plan file, chunks to sonnet agents in worktrees (bugs too, with their own CDP port), POLL the agents every ~5 min (worktree git status; ping after 10 min silent; notifications get lost), integrate from each worktree's diff against HEAD, hidden-desktop check in light and dark, board updated, nothing committed. No serial debugging or scratch edits in the main tree. TESTS: a subagent NEVER runs the full suite; its brief names the exact test classes it must pass. Regression (the full suite) runs once after integration, by a Fable merge subagent you spawn so the chat is not blocked. DIAGRAMS: ALWAYS draw a diagram with every explanation to the owner, in chat and in every plan, in the SAME reply (write <name>.excalidraw in the plans folder, run node DevResources/tools/excalidraw-to-svg.mjs, look at the render, link or embed the .excalidraw.svg). Never skip it to answer faster. Only a one-line factual answer goes without."
